description: The class/job system defines character archetypes, their skills, progression paths, and determines equipment compatibility via the 'wearable' field.

type.description: Job type/category identifier. Used to match equipment wearable field. Equipment whose wearable == job.type can be worn by this class.

skill.description: Array of active skill IDs available to this job

passive_skill.description: Array of passive skill IDs for this job

passive_imprint.description: Array of passive imprint skill IDs

change_times.description: Number of job change/promotion tiers this job represents

job_change.description: Array of job IDs that this job can change/promote into

model.description: Unit model ID used for visual rendering (references ConfigUnit)

recommend_skill.description: Recommended active skills for this job

default_transomg.description: Default transmog appearance (note: typo in original code)

arms_icon.description: Icon ID for the job's weapon type

arms_name.description: Name of the weapon type this job uses

front_job.description: Pre-requisite job ID (the job you must have before promoting to this one)

job_icon.description: Icon ID for the job class

skin.description: Default skin ID for this job

wakeup_system.description: Job awakening/wakeup progression system. Each job has multiple awakening levels that grant bonus stats.

fields.value_plus: Array of attribute bonuses granted at this awakening level, format: [[attr_id, value], ...]
fields.cost: Array of costs to reach this awakening level, format: [[item_id, amount], ...]
fields.power: Combat power value at this awakening level

equipment_relationship.description: Equipment items have a 'wearable' field (from ConfigEquipment). If wearable == 0, any job can wear it. Otherwise, wearable must match the job's 'type' field.

code_reference.logic: var n = e.wearable || 0; if (0 == n) /* any class can wear */; else { /* compare with configJobs.getDataByKey(job_id).type */ }

job_figure_usage.description: The player's figure data contains a 'job_figure' field that stores the current job ID. This is used to look up the job config and determine the character model.

job_passive_skill_slots.description: Global config defines the number of passive skill slots per job level tier

promotion_chain.description: Jobs form a promotion chain via the front_job field. A job with front_job=0 is a base/starting job. The job_change array lists possible next promotions.
promotion_chain.flow: Starting Job -> (job_change array) -> Advanced Job -> (job_change array) -> Expert Job -> ...
